limits: The complete proposed text is conditional on three added coordinate slots. No observed source slot is deleted or reordered, and the published key is unchanged.
Part 1 has one visibly four-symbol XAAF group, but the second gap has no directly visible location; its position is a cipher reconstruction conditional on the fixed complete candidate.
Part 2 has three equally low-cost insertion boundaries, 37, 38 and 39, inside or immediately after the short VF-- group. Boundary 37 is a display convention, not a uniquely recovered physical gap.
The gap searches are exhaustive only for the stated fixed text and deletion-only alignment families. They do not establish unique historical plaintext or the stage of loss.

The p145 and p211 sources independently support exact schedule and acknowledgment spans. They are differently worded dispatches and do not support identifying every letter or reference by copy equivalence.
The expanded word NACHRICHTENCHEF is an explicit local lexical repair, while the reference 4B47857 remains unchanged. No historical digit reassignment is claimed.
The telegram reports a key schedule; actual use by all stations is not inferred. Date, header and source records remain separate.
Earlier key recovery and published readings retain credit. This source restoration is not a first-decipherment claim.
